  • Constructor Details

    • GameModel

      public GameModel()
      Constructor for the GameModel class.

      Initializes the state and data structures of the game model. Specifically: - Initializes the game deck as an empty collection. - Initializes the players map to store player data. - Sets the default number of players to 2. - Sets the initial state as an instance of CreateGameState. - Initializes the mapping for player virtual views. - Sets up the queue handler for managing game events and starts its execution in a separate thread. This constructor is the starting point for creating a new GameModel instance and establishing the game's initial state and logic pipeline.

    • disconnectClient

      public List<StateDTO> disconnectClient(String nickname) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Disconnects a client from the game based on their nickname. Updates the player's connection status and modifies the current game state if necessary.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player to disconnect. Must match the name of an existing player in the game.
      Returns:
      a list of StateDTO objects representing the game's updated state, including the player's disconnection and potential state transitions to InsufficientPlayerState caused by an insufficient number of players.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the given player does not exist in the game.

    • reconnectClient

      public List<StateDTO> reconnectClient(String nickname, VirtualView clientView) throws Exception
      Handles the reconnection of a disconnected client to the server. This method verifies if the provided nickname belongs to a disconnected player, updates the player's connected status, assigns the new client view, and returns a list of game states required to synchronize the client with the current game phase.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player attempting to reconnect
      clientView - the instance of the VirtualView corresponding to the reconnecting client
      Returns:
      a list of StateDTO objects representing the current state of the game, including any reconnect-specific information
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided nickname does not exist in the disconnected players list or the game
      Exception - if an unexpected error occurs during the reconnection process

    • generateDeck

      private void generateDeck() throws IllegalStateException
      Constructs and initializes the deck of cards based on the current game level. This method loads event cards from an external source using CardLoader. The cards are filtered and categorized into different levels based on their data. Depending on the game level, specific subsets of cards are added to create the deck: - Level 0: All available cards are added to the deck. - Level 1: The deck is divided into 4 sub-decks, each containing two level 1 cards. - Level 2: The deck is divided into 4 sub-decks, each containing two level 2 cards and one level 1 card. - Level 3: The deck is divided into 4 sub-decks, each containing two level 3 cards, one level 2 card, and one level 1 card. If the specified game level is invalid, an IllegalStateException is thrown. After the deck is constructed, it is randomized using Collections.shuffle().
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the specified game level is not valid.
      RuntimeException - if an error occurs while reading the JSON file used for loading the cards.

    • addNewPlayer

      public List<StateDTO> addNewPlayer(String nickname, PlayerColor playerColor, VirtualView clientView) throws IllegalStateException, IllegalArgumentException
      Adds a new player to the current game state with the specified nickname and color, and associates the player with a corresponding virtual view (network protocol).
      Parameters:
      nickname - the unique nickname of the player to be added
      playerColor - the color representing the player in the game
      clientView - the virtual view object associated with the player
      Returns:
      a list of state representations (StateDTO) showing the changes made to the game state: the first element is always the response to the command, the second element, if present, is the transition to the next state (ShipConstructionDTO)
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the current game state does not allow adding a new player
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided arguments are invalid or violate game rules
